input: Map all the hiking trails within two hours away

gold.taskTitle: Map hiking trails within two hours of home
gold.taskDescription: Find and map all hiking trails accessible within a two-hour travel radius from the user's location.

questions.title: What is your starting location or home base?
questions.description: Identify the specific city, zip code, or address to use as the center point for the two-hour radius.

questions.title: Is two hours by car, public transit, or foot?
questions.description: Clarify the mode of travel used to calculate the two-hour travel time.

questions.title: What difficulty levels of trails are you interested in?
questions.description: Determine whether the user wants easy, moderate, hard, or all difficulty levels included.

questions.title: Do you have a minimum or maximum trail length preference?
questions.description: Establish any distance constraints for the trails to be mapped, such as only trails over 3 miles.

questions.title: What tool or format should the final map be in?
questions.description: Find out whether the user wants a Google Maps list, a printed map, a specific app like AllTrails, or another format.

questions.title: Are there specific trail features you want included?
questions.description: Determine if the user has preferences for features like waterfalls, summits, loops, dog-friendly trails, or paved paths.

questions.title: Is this for a specific upcoming date or ongoing reference?
questions.description: Clarify whether the map is needed for a planned trip soon or as a general personal resource to use over time.
